parent_objective: run one no-training collision-stratified outcome probe on M1419 source rows after branch synthesis
blocked_by: M1420 admits only one no-training outcome probe from M1419 before any training corpus export or further retune
supersedes: running another source retune after M1419

public_gates: M1421 must run no-training outcome probing only
M1421 must use M1419 matched/bucketed source rows
M1421 must preserve and report warmup gate collision/source diagnostics
M1421 must separate warmup-history-positive rows from reset and zero-current controls
M1421 must not train run PPO promote use private holdout export a training corpus or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim self-identification from source materialization
do not ignore the M1419 one-seed source-diversity miss
do not aggregate collision-heavy and collision-free rows without stratified reporting

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether the M1419 lower-invasiveness source rows create source-diverse outcome-relevant warmup-history intervention effects
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public no-training outcome probe only; no training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export paper-level or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if outcome rows are zero or normal viable rows collapse
stop if accepted rows are reset-only or zero-current-only
stop if history-positive rows are seed-thin
stop if wrong-warmup variants remain zero and warmup removal dominates
stop if history-positive rows occur only in high-collision source strata
stop if actor input changes are required
fallback_plan: route to result audit if outcome positives are sparse or reset-only
route to stricter repeat only if outcome positives are source-diverse and not collision-only
pivot or stop if M1419 outcome probe is again wrong-warmup-negative and seed-thin

training_stage.stage_objective: M1419 collision-stratified staged warmup outcome probe
admission_evidence: M1419 source volume warmup evidence and invasiveness gates are strong enough for diagnostic outcome probing
M1420 admits only no-training public outcome probing and blocks training corpus export
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: history-necessity and current-frame substitution limits are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1421 tests history intervention effects but must distinguish warmup-history variants from reset and current-frame substitution.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1419 staged warmup matched/bucketed source rows with 56-step histories.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If accepted rows are sparse reset-only current-only collision-only or wrong-warmup-negative record that and route to audit instead of weakening the self-ID standard.
allowed_claims: no promotion corpus export training PPO private-holdout high-fidelity paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The less invasive M1419 source rows will reveal whether staged warmup command-response history interventions produce more source-diverse outcome-critical effects than M1412.
success_criteria: outcome probe propagates source warmup gate diagnostics into outcome artifacts
summary reports accepted rows by variant and warmup gate collision stratum
summary reports warmup-history-positive rows separately from reset and zero-current controls
summary reports wrong_warmup_history_same_reveal and same_recent_wrong_warmup_history rows

failure_criteria: warmup gate collision/source diagnostics are missing from outcome reporting
